ai_summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (formerly Century Textiles and Industries Limited) has completed the slump sale of its entire 'Century Pulp and Paper' undertaking, including assets, liabilities, and employees, to ITC Limited on August 1, 2026. This divestment represents a material strategic pivot for Aditya Birla Real Estate, significantly impacting its operational focus, asset base, and revenue streams, likely solidifying its concentration on the real estate sector. The document itself serves as a standard notification of a pre-approved transaction completion and presents no immediate red flags.
